Limits: top_k primary matches, 10 excerpts overall, 2 complete sentences and 500 text characters per excerpt, and 3000 text characters overall. query.description: Non-blank search text. Prefer English corpus terminology, e.g. Brightwater population 2025 area.

Use AST parsing and whitelisted evaluation, never eval or exec. Limits: 512 expression characters, 128 AST nodes, depth 16 (root depth 1), and finite inputs/intermediate results/results with absolute value <= 1e15. Check length before parsing. Conversion applies input scale first, then compatible unit conversion: 1 km=1000 m; 1 km2=1000000 m2; 1 ML=1000 m3; 1 m3=1000 L. Reverse conversions are supported. one is dimensionless; one, KZT, person, pupil and school each convert only to the same label. No compound units, currency exchange or calendar conversion. Normalise quantities separately before calculating ratios. Return finite floating-point results without extra intermediate rounding; evaluate does not check units or the meaning of a formula.

expression.description: Required only for evaluate. Non-blank expression; use decimal points and no thousands separators.

value.description: Required only for convert. Numeric quantity before scaling; booleans are invalid.

scale.description: Optional only for convert. Input multiplier: 1, 1000 or 1000000. The tool defaults to one; output uses ordinary target units.

to_unit.description: Required only for convert. Compatible, case-sensitive target unit.
